caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent glass vessel with two handles. The vessel is primarily rendered in shades of pale greenish-blue with subtle variations in intensity to indicate its transparent and reflective qualities. The body of the vessel is rounded with a slight bulge in the middle, tapering towards the neck and the base. Two symmetrical, looping handles are attached to either side. The vessel stands on a short, stout stem that transitions smoothly into a wide, circular base. Decorative patterns, possibly floral or vine-like, are subtly etched or embossed onto the surface of the glass. The background is a uniform beige color, which contrasts with the vessel and makes it the focal point of the composition. The artist’s signature, "Van Silvay," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Sugar Bowl
